Title: A mission-granted reward is not just a bigger balance number -- it is genuinely spendable, deducted correctly from a balance that includes the just-earned grant, in a real Mixed Cart checkout on the very next order [JOURNEY]
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS] @td(MSN_E2E_REWARD_USER.email) / {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}  (type the NAME so Playwright --secrets redacts it)
[PRE:RESET_CART]
Store @td(MSN_STORE_SETTINGS.store_id) has @td(MSN_STORE_SETTINGS.setting_name)=true, Loyalty.Currency=@td(LOYALTY_SETTINGS.currency_code) in Mixed Cart mode. @td(MSN_E2E_ORDERVALUE.name) is Published, public, OrderValueGoal target=@td(MSN_E2E_ORDERVALUE.goal_target) reward=@td(MSN_E2E_ORDERVALUE.reward). MSN_E2E_REWARD_USER is a per-run, zero-balance account (it BORROWS the ephemeral LOYALTY_ZERO_USER identity) -- required because on the shared LOYALTY_VIP_USER (~964,189,233 PTS) a 500-PTS reward is ~0.00005% of the balance and no arithmetic could demonstrate the reward was genuinely earned rather than already present. suite 075d already proves the reward-grant arithmetic via the GraphQL runner and suite 083b already proves Mixed Cart redemption arithmetic from a pre-existing balance (cited in References as grounding evidence only) -- this case is the first to chain them: the balance being spent was earned from a MISSION in the same journey, not a pre-funded fixture account. LIMIT: because the account is freshly provisioned, its first order is ALSO a fresh account's first order for every other published store-wide mission (MSN_ZEROTARGET, MSN_LOCALIZED, MSN_PUBLISHED-PRIVATE, MSN_ZEROREWARD and similar count-1 fixtures all grant on a first order too) -- the exact co-grant set for THIS account was not measured at seed time (unlike MSN_E2E_ORDERVALUE_008's), so the earn checkpoint below is a lower bound, not an exact figure. The SAME shape recurs on order 2 and this case originally missed it: order 2 is itself a Mixed Cart order with a cash line, so BL-LOY-007(a) has it post its OWN Earned (ProductPoints) row, and any still-incomplete store-wide mission can co-grant on it as well (observed on run REG-2026-09-02-0930, where sibling missions co-granted on order 2 and an exact BAL_1 - PTS_LINE_TOTAL equality failed by exactly their sum while the redemption itself was correct). The spend checkpoint therefore BRACKETS order 2's own ledger entries with a cursor recorded at the BAL_1 read, instead of assuming there are none. It deliberately needs NO mission identifier: BL-LOY-015 is violated in product -- LoyaltyOperationLog exposes amount / createdDate / orderId / orderNumber and nothing that names a mission -- so a grant cannot be attributed to a specific mission and the assertions must not pretend otherwise.
